# Evomni site package checklist

Use this when you cannot run `scripts/check-site.mjs` (no Node.js). Check EVERY item against the finished site folder and report each as pass or fail with the file name; fix all failures before delivering. The IDs match the checker output. Details are in `spec.md`.

## Must pass (checker ERROR; some items also contain a WARN part, marked in the text)

1. [ ] **PAGE-TYPE**: Every .html needs <body data-evo-page="home|page|article-list|article-detail|product-list|product-detail">; list/detail pages need data-evo-collection="<lowercase letters/digits>"; exactly one home page per language and it is index.html (root index.html, en/index.html …); data-evo-category only on list/detail pages; one collection cannot be both article and product.
2. [ ] **FILE-NAME**: Page files live in the package root (main language) or in one language folder named after the language's route prefix (en/, ja/, zh-cn/ — lowercase, no deeper folders); file names use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (news-spring-launch.html), 2–64 characters before .html, not only digits, not a reserved word (admin, login, api, search, article, product, category, faq, album, download, member, cart, checkout…).
3. [ ] **STRUCTURE**: Direct children of <body> are exactly <header data-evo-shared="header">, <main>, <footer data-evo-shared="footer"> in that order (script/noscript/template may appear anywhere); anything else at body level is lost on import, so move it inside header, main or footer.
4. [ ] **SHARED-DIFF**: The header and footer must be identical on every page (only the current-item classes is-active/is-active-parent and aria-current may differ); copy them from the index.html of the same language folder (root index.html for root pages, en/index.html for en/ pages).
5. [ ] **MENU**: Exactly one nav[data-evo-menu] inside the header, built as nested ul > li > a at most 3 levels deep; no empty or # links; all li on one level share the same classes/structure (WARN); never hard-code is-active / is-active-parent in the menu.
6. [ ] **BODY**: Each detail page and each text page (data-evo-page="page" with a body) has exactly one [data-evo-body]; a page without one is a custom standalone page; list and home pages have none; it must not sit inside data-evo-repeat or data-evo-list.
7. [ ] **LAYOUT-DIFF**: Detail pages of one collection (and list pages of one collection) must have identical markup outside [data-evo-body] and the values of [data-evo-field] elements; all text pages must be identical outside [data-evo-body] except the text of data-evo-field="title", with no other data-evo-field outside the body; fix the differing element named in the message.
8. [ ] **FIELD**: data-evo-field values must be valid for the context (detail fields on detail pages, card fields inside [data-evo-item], category-cover/category-summary/category-banner/total-count on list pages outside cards, form-description on custom standalone pages, only title on text pages outside the body) and respect element rules: title required on detail pages, date is <time> YYYY-MM-DD, cover is <img>, link is <a>, gallery holds only <img>, or only slides of exactly one <img> each (max 20), price starts with <span data-evo-field="currency"> then a number, variants only on product-detail, other fields hold text only, max 5 custom fields per collection, data-evo-type only "option" on custom fields.
9. [ ] **REPEAT**: data-evo-repeat is empty or "fixed", has at least one child, all direct children have identical tag/class structure, no nested data-evo-repeat, no <br> inside items (WARN).
10. [ ] **LIST**: Each [data-evo-list] holds [data-evo-item] cards (2+ on list pages) of identical structure, each with a data-evo-field="link" to an existing detail page of the right collection; data-evo-source / data-evo-source-category must exist; data-evo-limit is 1-50 and only with data-evo-source; pagination needs a positive integer data-evo-page-size and only prev/number/current/next links; a list page has exactly one list without data-evo-source, other pages none.
11. [ ] **CATEGORY**: A list page's data-evo-category must equal a category used by at least one detail page of the same collection.
12. [ ] **ADJACENT**: prev-link, next-link, prev-title, next-title, prev-image and next-image may only appear inside [data-evo-adjacent] on detail pages.
13. [ ] **BREADCRUMB**: [data-evo-breadcrumb] must contain data-evo-crumb, data-evo-crumb-sep and data-evo-crumb-current elements; the page (or its collection's list page) should be linked from the main menu (WARN).
14. [ ] **FAQ**: [data-evo-faq] has only <details> children, each with exactly one <summary> (text only) followed by the answer content.
15. [ ] **TABLE**: Tables must not use rowspan or colspan (no merged cells).
16. [ ] **BUY**: data-evo-action (inquiry|cart|buy|notify|favorite) only on product-detail pages inside one [data-evo-buy] that also contains the price field; qty is <input type="number">; data-evo-option only inside the variants field; data-evo-if only "sale" and only on product pages.
17. [ ] **FORM**: Every <form> has exactly one of data-evo-form / data-evo-search / data-evo-filter; at most one data-evo-form per page and not in header/footer/repeat/list; every field has a label; only allowed input types; at most one data-evo-consent; search form has input name="q"; filter only on list pages with controls named custom:<name> of an option-type custom field.
18. [ ] **COMPONENT**: Newsletter: [data-evo-newsletter] holds exactly one <input type="email"> and at least one <button>/<a> with data-evo-newsletter-action="subscribe|unsubscribe", no <form>. Hot keywords: [data-evo-hot-keywords="auto|manual"] holds one <ul>/<ol> whose <li> each contain an <a> with the keyword text (optional heading outside the list = title; data-evo-limit 1–30 for auto; manual uses the <li> texts as the tag list). Related content (detail pages only, once per page): [data-evo-related] (article: latest-category|similar-tags, data-evo-limit 1–12; product: no value, data-evo-limit 1–20) holds sample cards that are themselves <a data-evo-item data-evo-field="link"> inside one wrapper element inside the container. Download list: one [data-evo-download="table|cards"] per page (home and standalone pages only) holding [data-evo-download-item] rows, each with data-evo-download-name, data-evo-download-date (table: YYYY-MM-DD; cards: year or full date) and one to three (table) or exactly one (cards) <a data-evo-download-file> pointing to a package file or an https URL; cards may add <img data-evo-download-cover>. Share buttons: [data-evo-share] holds one or more <a>/<button> each with data-evo-share-platform="facebook|line|x|linkedin|copy". Table of contents: one [data-evo-toc] per page holding one <ul>/<ol> whose first <li> (the sample item) contains an <a>; the list is built from the h2/h3 of [data-evo-article-region] (at most one; else <main>, else <article>). Video: [data-evo-video="YouTube-or-Vimeo URL"] with optional data-evo-video-mode="background|popup", data-evo-video-poster and data-evo-video-mobile-image (package image files).
19. [ ] **LINK-TYPE**: data-evo-link must be login, register, member, cart or inquiry-cart.
20. [ ] **CSP**: No on* event attributes, no javascript: URLs, no eval() / new Function(); a local <script type="module"> must point to a .mjs file; inline scripts should move to a .js file (WARN, JSON-LD is fine).
21. [ ] **REF**: Every relative href/src/srcset/poster and every url() in local CSS must point to a file that exists in the package; #id anchors need a matching id on the page; a bare # link is only allowed inside data-evo-pagination, data-evo-hot-keywords and data-evo-toc, or on a data-evo-newsletter-action or data-evo-share-platform link.
22. [ ] **LOCALE**: Language folders (en/ …) hold translations of the root pages: a page in a language folder that is not home or a list page needs a root page with the same file name (en/about.html ↔ about.html); same-named pages must have the same data-evo-page and data-evo-collection; same-named detail pages should have the same number of data-evo-category values, because category names are matched by position (WARN); with language folders, every language's index.html header should hold a [data-evo-lang-switch] language switcher (WARN). Missing list/detail/text pages in a language folder reuse the root layout.
23. [ ] **UNKNOWN-EVO**: Only the data-evo-* attribute names defined in the spec exist; remove or rename any other data-evo-* attribute. Also never use the platform's reserved attributes data-loop, data-field, data-if, data-href, data-src (the front end rewrites or drops those elements); rename them.

## Should pass (checker WARN; review each)

1. [ ] **JS-DATA**: Content must be written in HTML (R4): do not fetch()/XMLHttpRequest data and do not ship .json data files.
2. [ ] **IMG**: Give every <img> an alt attribute; CSS background images are decoration only and cannot be edited in the admin.
3. [ ] **BODY-CLASS**: Classes and other attributes on <body> are not kept; put a wrapper element with the class inside <main> instead.
4. [ ] **CSS-CONFLICT**: The same single-class selector must not set the same property to different values in two CSS files (all shared CSS is merged into one site stylesheet); rename one class.
5. [ ] **TITLE**: Every page needs a non-empty <title>, unique across the pages of one language folder.
6. [ ] **CATEGORY-LINKS**: 3 or more sibling links (or items of one menu level) with different texts must not all point to the same whole-collection list page: they all open the full list after import. A category link points to that category's list page (a list page with data-evo-category="<name>").
7. [ ] **CONTEXT**: Only with --context <site-context.md> (redraw of an existing site): every file name the site context pack suggests exists in the package root, a collection list page's <title> (without the site-wide suffix) is the site's collection title, a category list page's data-evo-category is the site's category title, and every data-evo-form title is a site form's title. A missing file or a mismatched category / form title makes the importer miss that part of the site; the list <title> is the fallback when data-evo-collection does not claim the collection.
